questions.question: An object is raised from the ground level first by 5m, then by 10m, and then by 15m. At what height will the object have maximum potential energy?

• Potential energy is defined as the energy stored due to change in position relative to others, stresses within itself, or many factors.
 
• The potential energy (U) = m g h [where m= mass of body, g= acceleration due to gravity, h = distance from the ground].
 
• Here, mass is denoted with [M], length with [L], and time with [T].
 
• If the height of a body increases from the ground its energy increases and vice versa.
 
• The Dimension of energy is - ML2T-2

**Explanation:**__

**Object 1:**

PE = mgh

Height = 5 m, Mass = m.

P.E₁ = m × g × 5 = 5mg

P.E₁ = 5 mg

**Object 2:**

PE = mgh

Height = 10 m, Mass = m.

P.E1 = m × g × 10 = 10mg

P.E1 = 10 mg

**Object 2:**

PE = mgh

Height = 15 m, Mass = m.

P.E1 = m × g × 15 = 15mg

P.E1 = 15 mg

Therefore, the highest potential energy has an object kept with a height of 15 m.

PE = __**15mg > 10mg > 5mg**__

• If g is the acceleration due to gravity, then

• Acceleration due to gravity is after shrinking is

Divide equations 1 and 2, we get

questions.question: Pipe A can fill an empty tank in 30 minutes, Pipe B can empty the same filled tank in 2 hours and Pipe C can empty the same filled tank in 5 hours. If all these are opened together when the tank is empty, then in how many hours will the tank be filled?

Total work = LCM of time taken by pipes individually

**Calculation:**

LCM of 1/2, 2, and 5 = 10

So, Efficiency of A = 20

Efficiency of B = 5

Eifficency of C = 2

Effective efficiency = 20 - 5 - 2 = 13

Time taken by three pipes = 10/13 hours

**∴ The tank will be filled in 10/13 hours**
